title: 第十九章 东宫藏戾气，风雨欲重来
content_zh:
柳氏被官府押走问罪、沈轻柔贬为庶女幽禁冷院的消息，短短半日便传遍了整座丞相府。

    府中彻底换了一番新气象。

    往日里靠着柳氏撑腰作威作福的下人尽数收敛锋芒，个个谨小慎微，各司其职。各处院落打理得干干净净，账目核对得清清楚楚，再无半分贪墨懈怠、搬弄是非的乱象。

    冷院深处，往日锦衣玉食、娇俏张扬的沈轻柔，如今只剩一身粗布素衣。院落荒草丛生，屋舍破旧阴冷，连取暖的炭火、日常吃食都是最粗劣的份例。

    她日日蜷缩在窗边落泪，往日的骄傲与野心被无尽的悔恨与恐惧吞噬。从前她高高在上，处处欺压嫡姐，觊觎她的一切，如今落得终生幽禁、不见天日的下场，才知十几年的荣华富贵，不过是一场虚妄泡影。

    可再后悔，也早已于事无补。

    汀兰院却是一片安然静好。

    连日紧绷的心事终于落地，沈清鸢难得清闲，翻出了生母遗留的旧物。一箱箱精致细软、手写诗笺、陈年摆件，件件温柔雅致，藏着母亲当年温婉通透的性子。

    指尖抚过泛黄的诗纸，字迹娟秀清丽，沈清鸢眼底微微发软。

    十几年沉冤，今朝得以昭雪。恶人伏法，污名尽散，母亲泉下有知，也该得以安息。

    春桃端着热茶进来，看着自家小姐松弛的眉眼，轻声笑道：“小姐，这下总算彻底安稳了。柳氏罪有应得，庶女也再翻不起风浪，往后咱们在相府，再也无人敢欺。”

    沈清鸢抬眸，轻轻摇头，眸底依旧藏着一丝审慎的清明：“府里的事了结了，外头的风波，才刚刚开始。”

    柳氏倒台，可真正藏在幕后、数次想要置她于死地的萧景煜，依旧安然待在东宫。

    禁足思过，看似是罚，实则未曾伤及根本。他仍是当朝储君，手中依旧握着数十年培植的东宫旧部与朝堂势力。那日海棠宴一败，丢尽颜面，积怨深重，以他狭隘阴狠的性子，绝不会就此善罢甘休。

    话音刚落，院外一名暗卫悄然入内躬身禀报。

    “大小姐，东宫近日异动频繁。太子禁足期间，暗中频繁联络朝中亲近派系大臣，私下传递密信，似是有意借朝堂之事，针对相府与相爷。”

    沈清鸢眸色瞬间沉了下来。

    果然。

    萧景煜从未打算认输。他知晓后宅算计再也拿捏不住自己，便打算转移战场，移步朝堂，针对父亲、针对整个沈家施压报复。
content_en:
The news that Mrs. Liu was taken away by the government for questioning and that Shen Qingrou was demoted to a concubine and imprisoned in the cold courtyard spread throughout the Prime Minister's Palace in just half a day.

    The mansion has completely changed into a new atmosphere.

    In the past, the servants who used to rely on Liu's support to do their best have all restrained their sharpness, and they are all cautious and perform their duties. All the courtyards are kept clean, the accounts are checked clearly, and there is no trace of corruption, slackness, or gossip.

    Deep in the cold courtyard, Shen Qingrou, who used to be well-dressed, charming and flamboyant, now only has a pair of coarse cloth. The courtyard is overgrown with weeds, and the house is dilapidated and cold. Even the charcoal fires for heating and daily meals are of the poorest quality.

    She curled up by the window and cried every day, her past pride and ambition swallowed up by endless regret and fear. In the past, she was aloof, bullying her sister-in-law everywhere, and coveting everything she had. Now she has been imprisoned for life, never to see the light of day. Only then did she realize that the glory and wealth she had enjoyed for more than ten years was nothing but an illusion.

    But regretting it will no longer help.

    Tinglan Courtyard is peaceful and quiet.

    After days of tense worries finally came to an end, Shen Qingyuan found a rare moment of leisure and dug out the old things left by his biological mother. Boxes of exquisite soft goods, handwritten poems and old ornaments, each tender and elegant, hide the gentle and transparent temperament of my mother.

    Fingertips stroked the yellowed poetry paper, the handwriting was beautiful and clear, and Shen Qingyuan's eyes softened slightly.

    After more than ten years of settling the injustice, now it can be vindicated. The evildoers have been punished and their reputations have been dispelled. Mother knows what she is doing under the spring, so she should be able to rest in peace.

    Chuntao came in with hot tea, looked at her young lady's relaxed brows, and laughed softly: "Miss, I am finally completely stable now. Mrs. Liu deserves what she deserves, and the concubine will no longer be able to make trouble. From now on, no one will dare to bully us in the Prime Minister's Mansion."

    Shen Qingyuan raised her eyes and shook her head slightly, with a trace of cautious clarity still hidden in her eyes: "The matter in the house is over, and the turmoil outside has just begun."

    The Liu family fell, but Xiao Jingyu, who was really hiding behind the scenes and wanted to kill her several times, was still staying safely in the East Palace.

    Being grounded to think about one's faults may seem like a punishment, but in fact it does not harm the root cause. He is still the current crown prince, and he still holds the old Eastern Palace headquarters and court power that he has cultivated for decades. That day, the Haitang Banquet was defeated, he lost face, and had deep grudges. With his narrow-minded and cruel temperament, he would never let it go.

    As soon as he finished speaking, a secret guard from outside the courtyard quietly came in and bowed to report.

    "Miss, there have been a lot of changes in the East Palace recently. During the period of confinement, the prince secretly frequently contacted the ministers of the close factions in the court and sent secret messages privately. It seems that he intended to use the court affairs to target the Prime Minister and the Prime Minister."

    Shen Qingyuan's eyes darkened instantly.

    really.

    Jamel Xiao never planned to admit defeat. He knew that he could no longer control the plot of the back house, so he planned to move the battlefield to the court to exert pressure and revenge on his father and the entire Shen family.
title_en: Chapter 19: The East Palace hides hostility, and the storm is about to come again
